obligations: Deliver ASD-STE100 and the five Exaix extension rules in the compiled contract
Preserve structured content, thought sections, and tags verbatim
Exempt documentation deliverables and cover status prose
Deliver metadata obligations in the body through the production formatter
Write the failing test before any source code; RED must come first
Use Exaix test helpers: initTestDbService, createCliTestContext, withEnv, MockLLMProvider, TestEnvironment.create
Keep coverage at line >= 70 and branch >= 60; add tests, never lower the threshold
Revert to the pre-RED state after two failed GREEN attempts and re-analyse the design
Add a module-header JSDoc block to new test and source files
Run the CI gates: lint, check, check:style, check:arch, fmt, check:magic
Keep 5-10 file batches when the scope exceeds about 20 files
Run deno task docs-sync-schemas after MCP handler changes
Follow the submodule-workflow skill for exaix-dev-docs changes
Keep docs/CHANGELOG.md to user-facing changes, one sentence per entry
Gate every user-visible step on a docs/Exaix_User_Guide.md grep before closing
Verify every runtime claim against source before writing it
Keep ARCHITECTURE.md strategic: what and why, not where
